acceptance.given: Two otherwise identical case-evidence inputs are prepared, with the second case supplied evidence originating from the first case and each case retaining its own immutable case identity and binding metadata.

oracle.expected: The validator rejects the cross-case substitution and emits a deterministic isolation or binding-mismatch diagnostic; no substituted evidence is admitted as proof for the second case.
forbidden: Evidence from one case is substituted into another case.
A case-count or summary result authorizes the substituted evidence.
oracle.observable: The isolated cross-case-substitution test records a failed validation assertion for the substituted case and confirms that no admissible assertion-to-case mapping is produced.

acceptance.then: The attempted substitution is rejected while independent case evidence remains bound only to its originating case.
acceptance.when: The cross-case-substitution fixture is executed with all non-substitution inputs held constant.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the isolated cross-case-substitution test and fail if evidence from case A is accepted for case B or if any runtime edge is emitted for the substituted mapping.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce immutable per-case evidence ownership so a receipt, assertion mapping, or runtime edge cannot be reused across distinct cases.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing quick-dev.case-contract.v1 schema and fail-closed behavior; rollback removes only the new isolation check and its fixture without rewriting historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: A cross-case substitution attempt transitions from untrusted mutable evidence to rejected evidence with no coverage authorization.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted isolation test passes only when the substituted evidence is rejected and the assertion-to-case mapping remains empty or invalid for the substituted case.
